purpose: G1.3b pilot: option B (Kindled 44-46 px, Scattered folk 48 px, soles on row 53 of 64x64) at true size, by generating on a canvas of about target / 0.75 and picking the candidate closest to the target height.
style_sentence: Top-down RPG pixel art seen from a low three-quarter view, light from the top left, a 1 px dark navy-violet outline, two or three shades per material, no dithering, transparent background, no text or letters.
description_rule: Job 1's create_character description for the NPC (it already ends with STYLE) with the height changed, + ' Facing the viewer, standing.' (= Job 1 (c) / Job 2 (a) Pro description with the new height). Rotations use the same description without the facing sentence, as in Jobs 1 and 2.
references_rule: exactly Job 2's reference_images (art/anchors/kindled-ash-s-64.png, same usage text), palette (28 whitelist colours), palette_name and max_colors (12); the anchor was re-uploaded because Job 2's upload ref expires after 3 days (same file, same sha256).
height_rule: opaque rows from the top of the head (hair, hood or crown) to the lowest opaque row; a rod rising above the head is not counted (measured with a pole tracer and checked by eye on every Kesh candidate). The player anchor's soles are on row 53; its Hookblade hangs to row 59, so it is 40 px.
images_passed_as: upload:<id> references from get_upload_url; no inline base64 anywhere
seed: 1234 on every create_image_pro call; create_character takes none. No retake, so 1235 was never used.

retakes.note: npc-tally met the hard-failure rule (no candidate within 4 px of 45: all 16 are 50-51 px). The retake was allowed but not used: all 16 candidates landed within 1 px of each other, so height is set by the canvas, not the seed, and seed 1235 on the same canvas would almost surely land at 50-51 again; a retake would also have cost the rotations for all three NPCs.

rejected_calls_not_charged: 1 of 16 parallel candidate downloads for npc-clerk was reset by the network and fetched again (no generation cost)

arguments.description: Old Kesh, a Kindled hermit and fisherman: a small figure made of river-dark brown-black clay, about 45 px tall, with a few widely spaced amber freckles like small lights, long white hair and a white beard, a patched grey-ochre sailcloth tunic with a wet grey patch, dark trousers and wrapped dark feet. He holds a long wooden casting rod upright at his side. Top-down RPG pixel art seen from a low three-quarter view, light from the top left, a 1 px dark navy-violet outline, two or three shades per material, no dithering, transparent background, no text or letters. Facing the viewer, standing.

reference_images.usage: character base: copy the proportions, the size on the 64x64 canvas, the clay-figure build, the outline and the shading style; NOT the outfit, colours or weapon

pick.why: Two candidates hit 45 px exactly (#4, #9); both face south and sit whole inside the canvas. #4 matches more of the description: amber freckle-lights and eyes, patched grey-ochre tunic, wrapped feet, rod held upright at his side. #9 has the longer rod (rising above the head) but carries an undescribed checkered net that reads as dither. Trade-off: #4's rod is shorter than 'long' and stays below the head.

pick_64.rule: pick canvas pasted unscaled, canvas centred horizontally ((64-w)//2 = 10), lowest opaque row on row 53; for the clerk (lowest row 55 on a 64-tall canvas) the top 2 rows, all transparent, fell off
